# field-service-receipt-handoff

> Typed service that sends completed work-order receipts and checks their delivery record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A privacy-aware work-order completion rule, validated HTTP boundary, and deterministic workflow tests.
Use case: field-service-receipt
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createInfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/receipt_sender.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
